honors.title: Dean’s List
honors.description:
Christopher Kyle Smith of Gainesville, GA, has been named to the spring 2016 Dean's List at the University of North Georgia (UNG).

The deans of each of UNG's five colleges - the College of Arts & Letters, the College of Education, the College of Health Sciences & Professions, the Mike Cottrell College of Business, and the College of Science & Mathematics - announced the names of some 1,800 students who made their respective lists.

Students earn Dean's List recognition by achieving a 3.5 grade point average, carrying 12 or more credit hours in one semester and having no grade lower than B.
honors.issuer: Issued by University of North Georgia · May 2016

projects.title: Content Management Website
projects.description: Content Management website built from the ground up using basic PHP, MySQL, and Bootstrap for the page layouts. The site allows users to login and post content for others to see and make comments. The Site has basic authorization with encrypted passwords. In the administrator section of the site the admin is allowed to delete and monitor comments, create posts, and even create or delete users.

projects.title: Ecommerce Website
projects.description: E commerce website built from the ground up using basic PHP, MySql, and Bootstrap for the responsive layouts. The site allows users to search through categories and add items to cart.  When the user wishes to check out the page sends items to Paypal with correct items and amount.  The back end of the application, under the admin tab, allows administrator of site to create new categories and products, edit product photos, and keep track of transactions. The site offers basic authentication using PHP and encrypted passwords. As well as security features to protect from SQL injection and database manipulation.
